description: ClinicalTrials.gov study search (official v2 API) by condition, intervention/drug, sponsor, location, keyword, recruitment status and phase. Useful for trial finding, pipeline and competitive research. Returns total count, NCT IDs, titles, status, phases, conditions, interventions, sponsor, enrollment, key dates, has-results flag and study links, with paging token, source URL and retrievedAt. Errors: 400 invalid input. PAID: $0.001 USDC per call on Base via x402 (MCP transport: retry with params._meta["x402/payment"]). Same tool over plain HTTP: GET /v1/clinical-trials/search.

status.description: comma-separated: RECRUITING, NOT_YET_RECRUITING, ACTIVE_NOT_RECRUITING, COMPLETED, TERMINATED, ...

name: clinical_trials_search
title: ClinicalTrials.gov study search
